E3SM 2.0 NARRM (2022): 
aerosol: MAM4 w/ new resuspension, marine organics, secondary organics, and dust (atmos grid)
atmos: EAM (v2.0, Dynamics: cubed sphere spectral-element grid, 130,088 columns; Physics: 2x2 finite volume cells within each spectral element, 57,816 columns. N. American (NA): 25 to 100 km; outside ~100 km. 72 vertical layers w/ top at 60 km)
atmosChem: Troposphere specified oxidants (except passive ozone with the lower boundary sink) for aerosols. Stratosphere linearized interactive ozone (LINOZ v2) (atmos grid)
land: ELM (v1.0, satellite phenology mode, atmos grid), MOSART (v1.0, 0.125 degree latitude/longitude)
landIce: none
ocean: MPAS-Ocean (E3SMv2.0, WC14to60E2r5 unstructured SCVTs mesh with 407420 cells, 1240672 edges, NA: ~14 km; outside: 30 to 60 km; 60 levels; top grid cell 0-10 m)
ocnBgchem: none
seaIce: MPAS-Seaice (E3SMv2.0, ocean grid, variable resolution 30 to 60 km; 5 ice categories; 7 ice, 5 snow layers)
